description: XrmToolBox plugin that turns the full Power Platform Admin (PPAC) + Business Application Platform (BAP) REST surface into a searchable, executable explorer. Browse 200+ documented operations (environments, environment groups, DLP policies, billing policies, governance, capacity, lifecycle, tenant settings), execute parameter-free GETs in one click, and inspect raw JSON responses — all using the XrmToolBox connection's signed-in user via silent MSAL token exchange. Same operation catalog as the standalone VerseOps WPF app.
releaseNotes:
v1.0.16.1 — Fix the validator catchall after checking current XrmToolBox docs and known-good packages: the XrmToolBox dependency version is the minimum XrmToolBox host version the tool targets, not just any historical marker. VerseOps builds against XrmToolBoxPackage 1.2025.10.74, and recent known-good multi-DLL packages such as FetchXML Builder declare dependency id="XrmToolBox" version="1.2025.10.74". v1.0.15.2 still emitted the legacy 1.2017.10.19 marker from old samples, so the portal likely treated the dependency as invalid/missing. Updated the injected marker to 1.2025.10.74. No code changes. v1.0.15.2 — Reissue v1.0.15.1 after fixing the GitHub Actions pre-push sanity check to allow the intended nested support-DLL layout. No package payload change beyond version metadata. v1.0.15.1 — Fix the v1.0.14.1 rejection (same misleading "XrmToolBox version dependency is missing" catchall). Root cause: known-good multi-DLL XrmToolBox packages put exactly one DLL directly in lib\<tfm>\Plugins\ (the actual tool assembly), and place support DLLs under lib\<tfm>\Plugins\<ToolAssemblyName>\. VerseOps v1.0.14.1 put MSAL + Api.Core DLLs beside VerseOps.XrmToolBox.dll in Plugins\, so the validator could scan a support DLL first and conclude the XrmToolBox dependency/tool metadata was missing. Fixed by keeping only VerseOps.XrmToolBox.dll at lib
et48\Plugins\ and moving VerseOps.Api.Core.dll plus MSAL dependencies to lib
et48\Plugins\VerseOps.XrmToolBox\. Also keeps the 4-part non-zero package/assembly version pattern so checklist rule #4 remains satisfied. No code changes. v1.0.14.1 — Fix the v1.0.13 rejection ("XrmToolBox version dependency is missing" — same misleading catchall error v1.0.10/11 got for a different rule). Root cause: official XTB validation checklist (https://www.xrmtoolbox.com/documentation/for-developers/deploy-your-plugin-in-plugins-store/plugin-validation-check-list/) item 4 requires "My tool library version is the same that my Nuget package version". Our v1.0.13 nuspec declared package version "1.0.13" (NuGet pack strips trailing .0 from 4-part) but the baked AssemblyVersion in VerseOps.XrmToolBox.dll was "1.0.13.0" because the CIL spec requires 4 ushort fields for AssemblyDef.Version. Fixed by using a 4-part version with a NON-ZERO 4th component (1.0.14.1) so NuGet preserves all 4 parts in the nupkg version, matching the assembly version exactly. Confirmed against canonical sample MsCrmTools.Iconator (2.YearStamp.MonthStamp.DayStamp date-stamped). No code changes. v1.0.13 — Fix the v1.0.12 "Logo Url is not valid" rejection. nuget.org’s flatcontainer icon proxy (https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/<id>/<ver>/icon) serves the embedded PNG with whatever Content-Type the .nupkg’s [Content_Types].xml declares for the .png extension. The XrmToolBox search index records this proxy URL as the package’s iconUrl when an <icon> is embedded, and the plugin-store validator rejects with "Logo Url is not valid" when the response Content-Type isn’t image/*. NuGet’s pack defaults the png ContentType to "application/octet", so the proxy was returning application/octet-stream. Fixed by extending the post-pack rewrite script to also rewrite [Content_Types].xml’s <Default Extension="png" /> entry to ContentType="image/png". No code changes. v1.0.12 — Move every shipped DLL under lib
et48\Plugins\ inside the .nupkg. The XrmToolBox plugin-store validator requires the plugin assembly to live in a "Plugins" subfolder of lib\<tfm>\ (per the canonical sample at xrmtoolbox.com — confirmed by inspecting MsCrmTools.Iconator 2.2025.3.15.nupkg, which packs MsCrmTools.Iconator.dll at lib
et48\Plugins\). When the validator can't find an assembly there it returns the misleading "XrmToolBox version dependency is missing in Nuget package" rejection — the same error v1.0.10 and v1.0.11 got even with a correctly-formed marker dep. Fixed by setting <IncludeBuildOutput>false</IncludeBuildOutput> (so the SDK Pack default no longer drops VerseOps.XrmToolBox.dll into bare lib
et48\) and explicitly <None Include>-packing VerseOps.XrmToolBox.dll + VerseOps.Api.Core.dll + the three MSAL DLLs into lib
et48\Plugins\. The CopyProjectReferencesToPackage MSBuild target is removed (replaced by the explicit Api.Core <None> entry). The marker dependency, iconUrl, embedded icon, and all v1.0.11 metadata are preserved. No code changes. v1.0.11 — Fix the v1.0.10 marker-dependency injection: NuGet's nuspec dependency model is "either grouped or flat, not both" — when any <group> child exists inside <dependencies>, loose top-level <dependency> siblings are silently ignored by readers (including the XrmToolBox plugin-store validator). The SDK was emitting an empty <group targetFramework=".NETFramework4.8" /> (because PrivateAssets="all" strips every real dep), and the inject script was appending the marker as a sibling — so the validator still reported "XrmToolBox version dependency is missing in Nuget package" against v1.0.10 even though the marker was textually present. v1.0.11 strips empty <group> elements before injecting, and if non-empty groups remain it places the marker inside each group instead of as a loose sibling. The resulting nuspec now matches the canonical pattern used by MsCrmTools.Iconator. No code changes. v1.0.10 — Inject <dependency id="XrmToolBox" version="1.2017.10.19" /> into the .nuspec via post-pack rewrite. The XrmToolBox plugin-store registration page rejects submissions whose nupkg lacks this exact dependency marker ("XrmToolBox version dependency is missing in Nuget package"), even though the package itself doesn't exist on nuget.org — the validator only reads it as a metadata signal. Our SDK-style csproj puts PrivateAssets="all" on every PackageReference so the dependencies group ships empty by default; this target writes the marker straight into the .nuspec inside the produced .nupkg, before the OIDC push step. No code changes; pure packaging metadata. v1.0.9 — Add <iconUrl> (deprecated by nuget.org but required by the XrmToolBox plugin-store registration page; submissions without it fail "Logo Url is not valid"). URL points at the immutable release tag so it can never 404 after a branch rename/merge. No code changes; reissue of v1.0.8. v1.0.8 — UI polish. Generic "Poll op" button is now always visible in the Response toolbar (next to Find next / Clear): if the last response carried an Operation-Location header it re-polls that URI, otherwise it GETs whatever is in the URL box, so you can paste any long-running operation URL and re-poll it without first selecting the matching catalog entry. Request and Response panels both painted SystemColors.Window (white) with a 2-px SystemColors.ControlDark splitter between them — no more "two grey strips with a wide grey gutter" look; the splitter is now the only visible boundary. Response-side search row rebuilt as a single-row TableLayoutPanel (columns: AutoSize label / Percent100 textbox / AutoSize info / 3×AutoSize buttons) instead of the prior Panel+Dock+FlowLayoutPanel, so Find next / Clear / Poll op share the textbox baseline at every DPI scale — matches the request strip's Send/Cancel/Decode-bearer alignment pattern. v1.0.7 — Description tab is now a styled rich-text view instead of a plaintext dump. The HTTP method is rendered as a color-coded pill (GET green / POST blue / PUT orange / PATCH purple / DELETE red), the URL in monospace, scope in gray, then the catalog prose. For PPAC ops whose catalog description embeds "  |  Docs: <learn url>", the Microsoft Learn URL is auto-detected as a hyperlink (RichTextBox.DetectUrls) and clicking it opens the docs in the user's default browser (System.Diagnostics.Process.Start) — no WebView2 runtime, no NuGet add, no HTTP fetch, no native DLL. v1.0.6 — Fix 16 PPAC catalog token mismatches: Apply to URL + Body silently no-op'd for Copy Environment, Get Environment Copy Candidates, Get/Restore Candidates, Restore Environment, Environment Group Role Assignments (3 ops), Rule Assignments by group, and all 8 Billing Policy + Billing Policy Environment ops. Root cause: shared OpParam.Token ("environmentId" / "groupId" / "policyId") didn't match those URLs' actual placeholders ("sourceEnvironmentId" / "targetEnvironmentId" / "environmentGroupId" / "billingPolicyId"). SubstituteTokens is a literal-name regex replace and preserved the {placeholder} as-is, so clicking Apply produced a URL still containing the literal token. Added Source/Target/EnvGroup/BillingPolicy Id param variants whose Token matches the URL character-for-character. UI: param-form dropdowns now go through the same FluentStyles pass as the URL/Scope/Search controls (Segoe UI 10pt, FlatStyle.System, FixedSingle borders) instead of looking 1-2pt smaller than everything else. Cached pickers (env / group / DLP / billing) surface their cache state on the Load button caption ("Load DLP (47)") and via per-row tooltip ("Cached 47 items — type to filter"), so it's obvious the data survived an op-switch and doesn't need re-loading. v1.0.5 — Host-startup + tab-close stability. Pack Microsoft.IdentityModel.Abstractions.dll alongside MSAL: MSAL 4.81 references it transitively for its telemetry surface, and without it XrmToolBox's MEF Assembly.GetTypes() scan throws ReflectionTypeLoadException during host startup, crashing Program.Main before the tile gallery renders. Make Dispose() idempotent on the plugin control: XTB can call Dispose(true) more than once on tab close, and the second call's Cancel() on the loader/executor CancellationTokenSource was throwing ObjectDisposedException and surfacing a crash dialog. v1.0.4 — Plugin-store polish: implements IGitHubPlugin (View on GitHub button on the tile), IHelpPlugin (? button → plugin README), INoConnectionRequired (no Dataverse connection prompt — the plugin uses tenant-level MSAL, not the host's IOrganizationService). Ships a dedicated plugin-focused README so the nuget.org / plugin-store landing page no longer pitches the standalone WPF app. New ISSUE_TEMPLATE + CONTRIBUTING.md in the repo. v1.0.3 — Catalog cleanup: corrected 5 BAP routes proven 404 by tenant-side verification. "Get environment" now uses /scopes/admin/ prefix (bare path 404s for tenant-admin callers). "List backups" BAP duplicate removed (PPAC equivalent works). "Get tenant settings" switched from GET to POST {} — listTenantSettings is an ARM-style list-action verb. "Update tenant settings" /scopes/admin/ prefix dropped. "Get DLP policy" documented (URL is correct, test-rig seed mismatch). v1.0.2 — Initial XrmToolBox store release. Search executes on Enter (not per-keystroke). FluentStyles theme pass. Tile branding (32x32 + 80x80 VerseOps mark).
